quest.title: Urgent Repairs
quest.description: Farrah was taking some goods to a spot near Drunkard Gorge to sell to passing trade caravans, but his transport was attacked by hilichurls, and now both he and the transport are in danger...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Certainly!

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: I appreciate it! Those monsters seem to want anything and everything they can get their hands on.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: No, please! Don't hurt me! No— ah? Traveler, where did all the hilichurls go?

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Great! Thank you so much! Are they really all gone?

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Phew... I owe you. That said, after all that fuss I won't be able to catch up to the caravan now.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: What's more my cart is broken. I need to get it fixed and head to the city before the fruit goes bad.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Once this much fruit goes bad— You can't even imagine the smell. I'll never manage to wash it out.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: I'm going to have to take stock again... I can already smell some of the fruit going bad.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Can you please help me by taking a look around for some materials to fix my cart with? A <color=#00E1FFFF>Sturdy Plank</color> should be enough to do it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Great! I'll wait for you here. Ugh, I wish I could find the fruits that have gone bad already...

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: This is plenty. I'll get this cart fixed up as soon as I've washed my hands...

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Huh? They're— they're back...! Traveler! They're baaaack!!!

talks.objective: Give the Sturdy Plank to Farrah

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: There has to be some rope nearby. Please, if you could just take a look for me.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Perfect. That'll see me as far the city, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help, Traveler. May we meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Ugh, how am I going to get rid of this awful smell...

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: There should be plenty of <color=#00E1FFFF>Sturdy Planks</color> in the forest. Please hurry, if we wait too much longer all the fruit will be lost.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Although, they seem pretty persistent. I can't stay here any longer, it's just too dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: They've bashed up the cart yet again. There's no point me trying to fix it up perfectly... I guess I'll just have to make do by wrapping a rope— Oh for heaven's sake, where is my rope!?

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: I cannot believe this! Those monsters must've run off with it. Traveler... how's about you see if you can't find me a nice bit of <color=#00E1FFFF>rope</color> around here...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm leaving this one to you.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Wait! Please... Smell that? Now imagine that, but a thousand times worse — that'll be my cart if I don't shift all this fruit before long! Please help me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Certainly not!

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Hey, wait! Wh—What if they come back, then what am I supposed to do!? An artillery of apples won't do much good!

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Come on, without your help I'll be done for!
